## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore `--wait` for the documented transition release so existing scripts can continue to run while their maintainers migrate to `--timeout`.

## Changes

The pull request renames the CLI option and parsed attribute to `timeout`, updates the parser tests, and adds an architecture decision describing the transition.

(none)

## Important

- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Retain `--wait` as a deprecated alias — Passing `--wait 12` exits with status 2 because the parser registers only `--timeout`. `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says, “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` fail immediately and miss the planned migration notice. — Fix: Accept both spellings into `args.timeout`, warn when `--wait` is used, and extend `test_explicit_options`.
